cells.gaps: No share of offices registering is held: 'all offices' (MAR-013, 2024-10-29) is the ministry's word with no count beside it, and the 59 of 97 (MAR-004, 2026-01-30) is over a programme's participating municipalities for a system whose function the report does not state. Later facts disagree with the 2024 account: in October 2025 communes were short of the paper registers called essential for registering births (MAR-009) and access to the national platform was still to be opened (MAR-010); MAR-014 gives the central connected platform as what the programme is to provide. The plan (MAR-016) carries no period, the domestic finance fact is from 2014 and outside the window, and the identifier at birth is held only as what Law 36-21 provides.
cells.note: SGEC enters births and deaths at the civil-status office and is past pilot, but its reach is a share equipped, which places at stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of offices shown registering on a share or a count over the country's own total, and none is held.
